name: Key Position
uniques: Gettysburg Scenario
Unbuildable
Unsellable
Never destroyed when the city is captured

civilopediaText.text: One of the seven key positions of the Gettysburg scenario: Oak Hill, Lutheran Seminary, Gettysburg, Cemetery Hill, Culp's Hill, The Angle, Little Round Top.
Each is a city that starts in Union hands and cannot be razed. At nightfall on July 3 (the end of turn 47) the army holding more key positions wins the Hold the Field victory.
Rifle pits, gun emplacements and stone walls make the position stronger to defend than an ordinary town.
